positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently on Cloud Spanner team. (2019 - present)

Previously on F1 team. F1 (see publications) is a distributed relational database built on top of Spanner and used by AdWords and numerous other internal teams.  I designed and implemented parts of many F1 systems, including: schema compilation, online schema change, authentication and authorization, change tracking and change notification, point-in-time-restore, multi-tenant support, foreign keys, functional indexes, column expressions. (2009 - 2019)

Previously technical lead of MySQL Development Group:  designed and implemented automated failover for replicated MySQL running in Borg cluster environment.  Used by AdWords and numerous other internal teams. (2007 - 2009)

Also implemented AdWords keyword suggestion servers. (2005 - 2007)

All of the above written in C++ and Python.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote bridges in C++ and Java to convert vendor tool XML metadata to and from MITI's OMG UML and CWM (Common Warehouse Metamodel) derived metamodel. 

Implemented algorithms to trace lineage and impact analysis through multiple stitched models.

positions.title: Database Software Engineer
positions.description: Wrote Perl and MySQL scripts and extended C++ Apache modules to manage large Linux cluster for massively multiplayer online virtual world.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led architecture and development of complex Java/J2EE Enterprise Business Process Management application for retail.

Wrote code generation tools (in Ruby) used by team to produce all tiers of multi-tier application: Database Schema (Oracle), Business Logic (BEA WebLogic EJB), Web Presentation (JSP).

Created and maintained ERwin/Oracle SQL schema.

Worked with subject matter experts for requirements analysis and ER and UML modeling.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Developed Certive Business Intelligence System, a web-hosted time tracking and project management application for professional services firms. Provided technical team leadership in database and whole system architecture areas.

Designed application semantics.

Developed web reporting system using HTML, Perl/Mason, SQL.

Wrote stored procedures in Oracle PL/SQL. Generated stored procedure skeletons from ERwin/Oracle schema input.

Maintained ERwin/Oracle schema.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead developer of EA Sports Tiger Woods PGA Tour Golf for the Palm Computing Platform.

Wrote technical design, panning playfield display, ball physics, computer AI players, game save logic. Programmed in C and 68000 assembly

Wrote computer AI players for ChromaGames backgammon (neural net) and chess and checkers (min-max search) games.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Chief architect for NetDirector, Newbridge's HP OpenView-based SNMP network management platform for UNIX and Windows NT. Provided technical team leadership in database and whole system architecture areas.

Designed database tables to model network devices, topology, and status.

Coordinated synchronization of data between HP OpenView and NetDirector databases.

Implemented C++ (ILOG Motif) and Java (AWT) GUIs and background daemons to discover and display ATM and Ethernet switch connectivity.

Implemented C++ (ODBC, DB-Lib) and Java (CORBA IDL, RMI, JDBC, JNI) classes to query and update Sybase and Microsoft SQL Servers.

Implemented all database tables and Transact-SQL stored procedures.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: TRW technical lead in joint development of spatial abstract data types for Ingres RDBMS.

positions.title: Technical Staff
positions.description:
Participated in development of parallel / clustered RDBMS server product (now Real Application Clusters).
 
Wrote regression tests.

Provided technical support to RDBMS customers.
